raw_source:
def noprofit_noloss(cost_price, selling_price):
    return cost_price == selling_price

# Test case from your example
assert not noprofit_noloss(1500, 1200)  # Should be False because there is a loss
print(noprofit_noloss(1500, 1200))      # Output: False (correct)

# Additional test cases for verification
assert noprofit_noloss(100, 100) == True   # No profit no loss
assert not noprofit_noloss(80, 90)         # Profit exists -> returns False
